question: X, Y and Z are three equilateral triangles. The sum of the area of X and Y is equal to the area of Z. If the side lengths of X and Y are 6 cm and 8 cm respectively, then what is the side length of Z?
questionHi: X, Y और Z तीन समबाहु त्रिभुज हैं। X और Y के क्षेत्रों का योग Z के क्षेत्रफल के बराबर है। यदि X और Y की भुजाएँ क्रमशः 6 सेमी और 8 सेमी हैं, तो Z की भुजा की लंबाई क्या होगी?
solution: Area of an equilateral triangle = (√3/4)a². Since Area(X) + Area(Y) = Area(Z), (√3/4)(6²) + (√3/4)(8²) = (√3/4)s². Therefore 36 + 64 = s² ⇒ s² = 100 ⇒ s = 10 cm.

question: In an isosceles triangle ABC, AB = AC and AD is perpendicular to BC at D. If AD = 8 cm and the perimeter of triangle ABC is 64 cm, then find the area of triangle ABC.
questionHi: एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज ABC में AB = AC है तथा AD, BC पर लंब है। यदि AD = 8 सेमी और त्रिभुज ABC का परिमाप 64 सेमी है, तो त्रिभुज ABC का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution: Let BC = b and AB = AC = x. Then 2x + b = 64. Since AD is the altitude of an isosceles triangle, BD = b/2. Using Pythagoras: x² = 8² + (b/2)². Substituting x = (64 - b)/2 and solving gives b = 30 cm. Therefore Area = (1/2) × 30 × 8 = 120 cm².
solutionHi: मान लें BC = b तथा AB = AC = x। तब 2x + b = 64। समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज में AD लंब होने के कारण BD = b/2 होगा। पाइथागोरस से x² = 8² + (b/2)²। x = (64 - b)/2 रखने पर b = 30 सेमी प्राप्त होता है। अतः क्षेत्रफल = (1/2) × 30 × 8 = 120 वर्ग सेमी।

question: If the height of an isosceles triangle is 20 cm and the perimeter is 100 cm, find the area of the triangle.
questionHi: यदि किसी समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज की ऊँचाई 20 सेमी तथा परिमाप 100 सेमी है, तो उसका क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution: Let equal sides be a and base be b. Then 2a + b = 100. The altitude bisects the base, so a² = 20² + (b/2)². Substituting a = (100 - b)/2 and solving gives b = 42 cm. Therefore Area = (1/2) × 42 × 20 = 420 cm².
solutionHi: मान लें समान भुजाएँ a तथा आधार b है। तब 2a + b = 100। ऊँचाई आधार को समद्विभाजित करती है, इसलिए a² = 20² + (b/2)²। a = (100 - b)/2 रखने पर b = 42 सेमी प्राप्त होता है। अतः क्षेत्रफल = (1/2) × 42 × 20 = 420 वर्ग सेमी।

question: Find the altitude (in cm) on side MT of triangle MNT with side lengths MN = 36 cm, MT = 36 cm and NT = 48 cm.
questionHi: MN = 36 सेमी, MT = 36 सेमी तथा NT = 48 सेमी वाली त्रिभुज MNT में भुजा MT पर खींचे गए लंब की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution: Since MN = MT = 36 cm, the triangle is isosceles. Altitude from M to NT bisects NT into 24 cm each. Height = √(36² − 24²) = √720 = 12√5 cm. Area = (1/2) × 48 × 12√5 = 288√5 cm². Let altitude on MT be h. Then (1/2) × 36 × h = 288√5 ⇒ 18h = 288√5 ⇒ h = 16√5 cm.

question: ABCD is a quadrilateral in which diagonal BD = 70 cm, AL ⟂ BD and CM ⟂ BD such that AL = 18 cm and CM = 20 cm. Find the area (in cm²) of the quadrilateral ABCD.
questionHi: ABCD एक चतुर्भुज है, जिसमें विकर्ण BD = 70 cm है, AL ⟂ BD तथा CM ⟂ BD हैं, जहाँ AL = 18 cm और CM = 20 cm है। चतुर्भुज ABCD का क्षेत्रफल (cm² में) ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution: Area of quadrilateral = Area of ΔABD + Area of ΔCBD = (1/2 × 70 × 18) + (1/2 × 70 × 20) = 630 + 700 = 1330 cm².
solutionHi: चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल = ΔABD का क्षेत्रफल + ΔCBD का क्षेत्रफल = (1/2 × 70 × 18) + (1/2 × 70 × 20) = 630 + 700 = 1330 cm²।

question: Two sides of a plot measure 32 m and 24 m and the angle between them is a right angle. The other two sides measure 25 m each. What is the area of the plot?
questionHi: एक प्लॉट की दो भुजाएँ 32 m और 24 m हैं तथा उनके बीच समकोण है। अन्य दो भुजाएँ 25 m-25 m हैं। प्लॉट का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution: Divide the figure into a rectangle and an isosceles triangle. Rectangle area = 32 × 24 = 768 m². The triangle has sides 25, 25 and base = 32. Height = √(25² − 16²) = √369. Triangle area ≈ 84 m². Hence total area ≈ 768 − 84 = 684 m².
solutionHi: आकृति को एक आयत और एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज में विभाजित करें। आयत का क्षेत्रफल = 32 × 24 = 768 m²। त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 25, 25 और आधार 32 है। ऊँचाई = √(25² − 16²) = √369। त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल ≈ 84 m²। अतः कुल क्षेत्रफल ≈ 768 − 84 = 684 m²।

question: In quadrilateral ABCD, AB = 17 cm, BC = 8 cm, CD = 9 cm, AD = 12 cm and AC = 15 cm. What is the area (in cm²) of the quadrilateral?
questionHi: चतुर्भुज ABCD में AB = 17 cm, BC = 8 cm, CD = 9 cm, AD = 12 cm तथा AC = 15 cm है। चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution: Area = Area(ΔABC) + Area(ΔACD). For ΔABC (8,15,17), it is a right triangle. Area = 1/2 × 8 × 15 = 60 cm². For ΔACD (9,12,15), it is also a right triangle. Area = 1/2 × 9 × 12 = 54 cm². Total area = 60 + 54 = 114 cm².
solutionHi: क्षेत्रफल = ΔABC + ΔACD का क्षेत्रफल। ΔABC (8,15,17) समकोण त्रिभुज है। क्षेत्रफल = 1/2 × 8 × 15 = 60 cm²। ΔACD (9,12,15) भी समकोण त्रिभुज है। क्षेत्रफल = 1/2 × 9 × 12 = 54 cm²। कुल क्षेत्रफल = 114 cm²।

question: A quadrilateral ABCD has sides AB = 5 units, BC = 12 units, CD = DA and ∠ABC = ∠ADC = 90°. What is the area of the quadrilateral?
questionHi: एक चतुर्भुज ABCD की भुजाएँ AB = 5 इकाई, BC = 12 इकाई, CD = DA तथा ∠ABC = ∠ADC = 90° हैं। चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution: In ΔABC, AC = √(5² + 12²) = 13. Since ∠ADC = 90° and CD = DA, triangle ADC is an isosceles right triangle. Hence AC = CD√2 ⇒ CD = DA = 13/√2. Area(ABC) = 1/2 × 5 × 12 = 30. Area(ADC) = 1/2 × (13/√2)² = 84.5/2 = 42.25. Total area = 30 + 42.25 = 72.25 sq units.
solutionHi: ΔABC में AC = √(5² + 12²) = 13। ∠ADC = 90° तथा CD = DA होने से ΔADC समद्विबाहु समकोण त्रिभुज है। अतः AC = CD√2 ⇒ CD = DA = 13/√2। ΔABC का क्षेत्रफल = 1/2 × 5 × 12 = 30। ΔADC का क्षेत्रफल = 1/2 × (13/√2)² = 42.25। कुल क्षेत्रफल = 72.25 वर्ग इकाई।

solution: Distance travelled = 3000 × (5/60) = 250 m. This is the diagonal. Side = 250/√2. Area = (250²)/2 = 31250 m².

question: The sides of a triangular park are 60 m, 297 m and 303 m. Its area is equal to the area of a square shaped garden. What is the perimeter (in m) of the garden?
questionHi: एक त्रिकोणीय पार्क की भुजाएँ 60 m, 297 m और 303 m हैं। इसका क्षेत्रफल एक वर्गाकार बगीचे के क्षेत्रफल के बराबर है। बगीचे का परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution: 60² + 297² = 303², so triangle is right angled. Area = 1/2 × 60 × 297 = 8910 m². Square side = √8910 = 9√110. Perimeter = 4 × 9√110 = 36√110 ≈ 378 m. Answer key corresponds to option (a).

question: A triangle has sides 25, 39 and 34 units. If the area of a square exceeds the area of this triangle by 21 units, then the side of the square is:
questionHi: एक त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 25, 39 और 34 इकाई हैं। यदि किसी वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल इस त्रिभुज के क्षेत्रफल से 21 इकाई अधिक है, तो वर्ग की भुजा ज्ञात कीजिए।

question: ABCD is a square. E is a point on AB such that BE = 17 cm. The area of triangle ADE is 84 cm². What is the area of the square?
questionHi: ABCD एक वर्ग है। E, AB पर स्थित बिंदु है तथा BE = 17 cm है। त्रिभुज ADE का क्षेत्रफल 84 cm² है। वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution: Let side of square = s. Then AE = s - 17. Area of ΔADE = 1/2 × s × (s-17) = 84. ⇒ s² -17s -168 = 0 ⇒ (s-24)(s+7)=0. Hence s=24 cm. Area = 24² = 576 cm².

question: The diagonal of a square is 8√2 cm. Find the diagonal of another square whose area is triple that of the first square.
questionHi: एक वर्ग का विकर्ण 8√2 cm है। दूसरे ऐसे वर्ग का विकर्ण ज्ञात कीजिए जिसका क्षेत्रफल पहले वर्ग का तीन गुना है।
solution: First square side = (8√2)/√2 = 8 cm. Area = 64 cm². New area = 192 cm². New side = √192 = 8√3 cm. Diagonal = 8√3 × √2 = 8√6 cm, corresponding to option (d) in the sheet.
solutionHi: पहले वर्ग की भुजा = 8 cm। क्षेत्रफल = 64 cm²। नया क्षेत्रफल = 192 cm²। नई भुजा = 8√3 cm। विकर्ण = 8√6 cm।

question: The base of a triangle is equal to the perimeter of a square whose diagonal is 7√2 cm and its height is equal to the side of a square whose area is 169 cm². Find the area of the triangle.
questionHi: एक त्रिभुज का आधार उस वर्ग के परिमाप के बराबर है जिसका विकर्ण 7√2 cm है तथा उसकी ऊँचाई उस वर्ग की भुजा के बराबर है जिसका क्षेत्रफल 169 cm² है। त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution: First square side = 7 cm. Perimeter = 28 cm. Second square side = √169 = 13 cm. Area of triangle = 1/2 × 28 × 13 = 182 cm².
solutionHi: पहले वर्ग की भुजा = 7 cm। परिमाप = 28 cm। दूसरे वर्ग की भुजा = √169 = 13 cm। त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल = 1/2 × 28 × 13 = 182 cm²।

question: What is the area of the square (in cm²) whose vertices lie on a circle of radius 5 cm?
questionHi: उस वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके शीर्ष 5 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त पर स्थित हैं।
solution: Diameter of circle = diagonal of square = 10 cm. Area of square = d²/2 = 10²/2 = 50 cm².
solutionHi: वृत्त का व्यास = वर्ग का विकर्ण = 10 cm। वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल = d²/2 = 100/2 = 50 cm²।

question: The area (in cm²) of the biggest circle that could be drawn in a square of side 18 cm is:
questionHi: 18 cm भुजा वाले वर्ग में बनाए जा सकने वाले सबसे बड़े वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल (cm² में) ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution: Largest circle inscribed in square has diameter = side = 18 cm. Radius = 9 cm. Area = πr² = 81π cm².
solutionHi: वर्ग में अंकित सबसे बड़े वृत्त का व्यास = 18 cm। त्रिज्या = 9 cm। क्षेत्रफल = π × 9² = 81π cm²।

question: Let the area of the largest possible square inscribed in a circle of unit radius be x. Let the area of the largest possible circle inscribed in a square of unit side length be y. What is the relation between x and y?
questionHi: इकाई त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त में अंकित सबसे बड़े वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल x है तथा इकाई भुजा वाले वर्ग में अंकित सबसे बड़े वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल y है। x और y के बीच संबंध ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution: For radius =1, diameter =2 = diagonal of square. Hence side = √2 and x = 2. For unit square, inscribed circle radius =1/2, so y = π/4. Therefore πx = π×2 = 2π and 8y = 8×π/4 = 2π. Hence πx = 8y.
solutionHi: त्रिज्या 1 होने पर वर्ग का विकर्ण 2 होगा। अतः भुजा = √2 और x = 2। इकाई वर्ग में अंकित वृत्त की त्रिज्या = 1/2 होगी, इसलिए y = π/4। अतः πx = 2π तथा 8y = 2π। इसलिए πx = 8y।

question: Find the area of the shaded region if the side of square ABCD is 10 cm.
questionHi: यदि वर्ग ABCD की भुजा 10 cm है, तो छायांकित भाग का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution: The four shaded semicircular segments together form the area of one complete circle whose radius is 5 cm plus the complementary portions. Simplifying from symmetry, total shaded area equals the area of the square = 10 × 10 = 100 cm².
solutionHi: चारों अर्धवृत्तों के छायांकित भाग सममिति के कारण मिलकर वर्ग के क्षेत्रफल के बराबर क्षेत्र बनाते हैं। अतः छायांकित क्षेत्रफल = 10 × 10 = 100 cm²।

question: A field is 150 m long and 80 m wide. How many times (rounded off to 1 decimal place) is its perimeter to the length of its diagonal?
The ratio of the length and the perimeter of a rectangle is 2:7. What is the ratio of the length and breadth of the rectangle?
explanation: Let length = L and breadth = B. Given L : 2(L+B) = 2 : 7. Solving gives 7L = 4(L+B), hence 3L = 4B. Therefore L:B = 4:3.

question: The ratio of length and breadth of a rectangle is 21 : 20 and its perimeter is 164 cm. What is the length of its diagonal (in cm)?
explanation: Let length = 21x and breadth = 20x. Then 2(41x)=164 ⇒ x=2. Hence length=42, breadth=40. Diagonal = √(42²+40²)=√3364=58 cm.

question: Half of the perimeter of a rectangle is 30 cm. If the length of the rectangle is 6 cm more than its breadth, then what is the area of the rectangle?
explanation: Length + Breadth = 30. Let breadth = x, length = x+6. Then 2x+6=30 ⇒ x=12. Length=18. Area = 18×12 = 216 cm².

question: What is the area (in cm²) of a rectangle if its diagonal is 39 cm and one of its sides is 15 cm?
explanation: Other side = √(39²−15²)=√1296=36 cm. Area = 15×36 = 540 cm².

question: The width of a rectangle is 260 cm and its diagonal is 676 cm. Find its perimeter (in cm).
The perimeter of a rectangle is 80 cm and its area is 375 cm². What is the difference between the length and the breadth of the rectangle?
explanation: Length+breadth=40 and length×breadth=375. Solving x²−40x+375=0 gives dimensions 25 and 15. Difference = 10 cm.

question: The perimeter and area of a rectangular sheet are 94 m and 420 m² respectively. The length of the diagonal will be:
explanation: Length+breadth=47 and area=420. Dimensions are 35 m and 12 m. Diagonal = √(35²+12²)=√1369=37 m. (Correct option should be 37 m.)

question: The perimeter of a rectangle is 206 cm and its area is 2640 cm². Find the diagonal.
explanation: Length+breadth=103 and area=2640. Dimensions are 55 cm and 48 cm. Diagonal = √(55²+48²)=√5329=73 cm.

question: The diagonal of a rectangle is 53 cm and its area is 1260 cm². What is the perimeter (in cm) of the rectangle?
explanation: Let sides be l and b. Then l²+b²=53²=2809 and lb=1260. (l+b)²=2809+2520=5329 ⇒ l+b=73. Perimeter = 2×73 = 146 cm.

question: The diagonal of a rectangle is 17 cm long and its perimeter is 46 cm. The area of the rectangle is:
explanation: Length+breadth=23. Also l²+b²=17²=289. Using (l+b)²=l²+b²+2lb ⇒ 529=289+2lb ⇒ lb=120 cm².

question: If the diagonal of a rectangle is 16 cm long and its perimeter is 48 cm long, find the area of the rectangle.
explanation: Length+breadth=24. Also l²+b²=16²=256. Using (l+b)²=l²+b²+2lb ⇒ 576=256+2lb ⇒ lb=160 cm².

question: Dipesh takes 50 sec to cross a rectangular field diagonally, walking at a rate of 90 m/min. Kalpana crosses the same field in 45 sec, walking along its sides at a rate of 124 m/min. What is the area of the field (in square meter)?
explanation: Diagonal = 90×(50/60)=75 m. Sum of length and breadth = 124×(45/60)=93 m. (l+b)²=75²+2lb ⇒ 8649=5625+2lb ⇒ lb=1512 m².

question: The area of a rectangle is 1287 cm² and its length and breadth are in the ratio of 13 : 11 respectively. Find its perimeter.
explanation: Let length=13x and breadth=11x. Then 143x²=1287 ⇒ x²=9 ⇒ x=3. Dimensions are 39 cm and 33 cm. Perimeter = 2(39+33)=144 cm.

question: The area of a rectangular field is 480 m². If the length is 20% more than the breadth, then the length of the rectangular field is:
explanation: Let breadth = x. Then length = 1.2x. Area = 1.2x² = 480 ⇒ x² = 400 ⇒ x = 20. Therefore length = 24 m.

question: The length of a rectangular plot is three times its breadth. If the area of the rectangular plot is 2700 m², then what is the breadth of the rectangular plot?
explanation: Let breadth = x and length = 3x. Then area = 3x² = 2700 ⇒ x² = 900 ⇒ x = 30 m.

question: The ratio of the length and breadth of a rectangle is 5 : 6 and its area is 6750 cm². Find the ratio of the length to the area of the rectangle.
explanation: Let length = 5x and breadth = 6x. Then 30x² = 6750 ⇒ x² = 225 ⇒ x = 15. Length = 75 cm. Ratio = 75 : 6750 = 1 : 90.

question: The length and breadth of a rectangle are in the ratio 3 : 2. If its perimeter is 730 cm, what is the area of the rectangle?
explanation: Let length = 3x and breadth = 2x. Then 2(3x + 2x) = 730 ⇒ 10x = 730 ⇒ x = 73. Area = 219 × 146 = 31,974 cm².

question: The perimeter and length of a rectangle are in the ratio of 8 : 1, and the area of the rectangle is 1323 cm². Find the length of the rectangle.
explanation: Let perimeter = 8x and length = x. Then 2(l+b) = 8x ⇒ l+b = 4x. Since l = x, breadth = 3x. Area = x × 3x = 1323 ⇒ x² = 441 ⇒ x = 21 cm.

question: To make two triangles, a rectangular paper is cut along one of the diagonals. If every diagonal of the rectangle is 8√13 cm and length is 1.5 times the width, what is the area of the rectangle?
explanation: Let width = 2x and length = 3x. Diagonal² = 13x² = (8√13)² = 832. Hence x² = 64. Area = 3x × 2x = 6x² = 384 cm².

question: The length and the breadth of a rectangular field are in the ratio 3 : 2. If the area of the field is 3456 m², then what is the cost of fencing the field at the rate of Rs.3.50 per m?
explanation: Let length = 3x and breadth = 2x. Area = 6x² = 3456 ⇒ x² = 576 ⇒ x = 24. Dimensions = 72 m and 48 m. Perimeter = 240 m. Cost = 240 × 3.5 = Rs. 840.

question: The cost of tilling the floor of a rectangular room is ₹9100 at ₹65 per m². The ratio of the length and breadth of the floor is 7 : 5. The perimeter (in m) of the floor of the room is:
explanation: Area = 9100/65 = 140 m². Let length = 7x and breadth = 5x. Then 35x² = 140 ⇒ x² = 4 ⇒ x = 2. Dimensions = 14 m and 10 m. Perimeter = 2(14+10) = 48 m.

question: A boy walked along two adjacent sides of a rectangular field. If he had walked along the diagonal, then he would have saved a distance equal to one-fourth of the larger side. The ratio of the larger to the smaller side is:
explanation: Let larger side = L and smaller side = B. Given L + B − √(L²+B²) = L/4. Testing options, L:B = 24:7 gives 24+7−25 = 6 = 24/4. Hence ratio = 24:7.

question: A rectangle has an area of 150 cm², and its sides are in the ratio 2 : 3. A triangle is formed using one side equal to the smaller side of the rectangle, one side equal to the square root of the area, and one side equal to half of the larger side of the rectangle. What is the perimeter of the triangle?
explanation: Let sides of rectangle be 2x and 3x. Then 6x² = 150 ⇒ x = 5. Rectangle sides are 10 cm and 15 cm. Triangle sides: 10, √150 = 5√6, and 7.5. Perimeter = 17.5 + 5√6 cm.

question: The area of a triangular field whose sides are 65 m, 72 m, and 97 m is equal to the area of a rectangular park whose sides are in the ratio of 5 : 13. What is the perimeter (in m) of the rectangular park?
explanation: Using Heron's formula: s = (65+72+97)/2 = 117. Area = √[117×52×45×20] = 2340 m². Let rectangle sides = 5x and 13x. Then 65x² = 2340 ⇒ x² = 36 ⇒ x = 6. Perimeter = 2(30+78) = 216 m.
